subject: Post-demo: MedAlign bakeoff alignment & proposed probe list
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@medalign.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: MedAlign bakeoff alignment & proposed probe list

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap from our side and a suggested set of probes/tests so we can set expectations for the bakeoff. Short version up front: we heard reliability at scale, per-token cost, and secure on-prem/ VPC deployment as your top three decision drivers.

Key pain points you called out
- Latency spikes during high concurrency (99th pct) causing back-office timeouts
- Current vendor limits on per-request context (need >= 8k tokens)
- Lack of clear data residency / encryption docs for clinical data ingestion

Goals for the next 60 days
- Run a 2-week side-by-side POC comparing latency/cost/quality on 3 representative workloads (triage summarization, chart extraction, patient Q&A)
- Validate integration with your VPC + KMS for key management
- Produce a bakeoff matrix that maps decision criteria to pass/fail probes

Suggested probes (we'll provide scripts + sample prompts):
1) Performance: 99th-percentile latency at 256/1k tokens under 50/200 concurrent connections (baseline target: 300ms @ 256 tokens).
2) Throughput: sustained throughput for 1M tokens/hour with graceful degradation policy.
3) Accuracy/QoS: quality A/B on 1k prompt set (MedAlign prompts) with human spot checks.
4) Context handling: end-to-end test demonstrating stable KV-cache across 8k token window.
5) Security/compliance: provide SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration proof, and an on-prem deployment checklist.
6) Cost modeling: normalized cost per 1M tokens with quantization and batching configs.

Open questions we need from you to finalize scope
- Which set of prompts do you want included in the 1k evaluation? (we can start with our default medical prompt pack if you prefer)
- Who from your infra/procurement teams should we loop in for the VPC/KMS setup?
- Target signoff date (internal) for vendor decision?

Next steps (proposal)
- We’ll share a 2-tab bakeoff workbook (attached) that maps each probe to evaluation criteria and required artifacts.
- If the scope looks right, we’ll provision a dedicated POC pool (Redwood Dedicated) and share technical onboarding docs within 48 hours.
- Schedule a 45-min tech deep-dive next week with your infra and engineering leads.

Attachments: medalign-bakeoff-probes.xlsx (probe list + acceptance criteria), redwood-security-summary.pdf (SOC2 + KMS integration overview)

Thanks — I’ll hold a 1-hour slot on Thurs 07/01 for the deep dive; if that works for you I’ll send a calendar invite.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MedAlign bakeoff alignment & proposed probe list

Naomi — really helpful summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Prompt set: please start with Redwood's medical prompt pack + our internal triage set (I uploaded a seed file to the Drive link you shared). We’ll send the remaining 400 prompts by EOD Thursday.

2) Stakeholders: Infra lead will be Selena (cc'd). Procurement will be looped for contracts and timing (procurement@medalign.com). For the decision committee, plan for a final readout with me, Dr. Priya Rao (clinical lead) and our VP of Product.

3) Timeline: we are trying to close vendor selection by mid-August. Two-week POC window in early July aligns well with our internal schedule.

4) A note on scope: for the latency probe, can we add one more real-world check — end-to-end API response time including our pre/post-processing (we can share a small dockerized wrapper to include in the test harness).

If Redwood can provide the POC environment and the security artifacts this week, procurement will fast-track an SOW. Please include any required IP/Data handling language up front so procurement can review.

Thanks — let us know which dates you propose for the infra deep-dive and we’ll block calendars.

—Alex
Alex Smith
Director of Engineering, Platform | MedAlign Health
alex.smith@medalign.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:01:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: MedAlign bakeoff alignment & proposed probe list

Naomi / Jonas — quick internal note before we finalize the workbook and invite list. Key negotiation levers we should emphasize:
- Offer a short-term credit for the POC to remove procurement friction (we can propose $10k credit applied to the first month of Dedicated usage).
- Emphasize our VPC/KMS automation to reduce infra lift (provide config snippets in the onboarding doc).
- For the latency test, recommend we run both optimized quantized and fp16 variants so they can compare quality vs cost.

Proposed acceptance thresholds (we should put these in the matrix):
- Latency: p50 < 150ms @ 256 tokens, p99 < 600ms under 200 concurrent connections.
- Quality: no more than 2% degradation in key-extraction F1 vs their baseline on the 1k prompt set.
- Integration: VPC peering + KMS proof within 7 business days of POC start.

Jonas — can you take the lead on the bakeoff workbook edits (update the perf thresholds + add the cost sheet)? Naomi, I’ll draft the procurement note offering the $10k POC credit for approval.

—Marissa
VP Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
